messages.author: b742296e4d6ce88e
messages.subject: Factor Score Path Analysis
parts:
Hello everybody,
I was thrilled by this new paper "Factor Score Path Analysis" by Ines Devlieger and Yves Rosseel (2017). I would like to perform a Factor Score Path Analysis using lavaan, so I was wondering whether the lavaan syntax is available or not.

To perform this analysis do I have to use on my CFA model the function below

LacPredict(fit, method = "regression")

and then perform a path analysis? Do you recommend to use the bootstrap or robust methods for calculating standard errors?

Any help will be greatly appreciated.

Best,
David

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Factor Score Path Analysis
parts:
On 11/10/2017 05:20 PM, David Giofrè wrote:
> Hello everybody,
> I was thrilled by this new paper "Factor Score Path Analysis" by Ines
> Devlieger and Yves Rosseel (2017). I would like to perform a Factor
> Score Path Analysis using lavaan, so I was wondering whether the lavaan
> syntax is available or not.

As an experimental feature, lavaan includes the function fsr() (for
factor score regression). See

?fsr

for more information.

fsr() will normally only provide point estimates for the structural part
of the model. There are no standard errors (yet). Bootstrapping would
certainly work, but you will have to set this up yourself.

Eventually, fsr() may be used as a replacement for sem() in certain
cases, but we are not there yet.

Yves.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Factor Score Path Analysis
parts:
lavaan reports not to find "fsr" (also ?fsr results in "could not find function "fsr").

This is not a public function (still experimental, needs some kinks worked out and simulations to figure out the wisest defaults), but you can access the hidden feature:

model <- '
  # latent variable definitions
     ind60 =~ x1 + x2 + x3
     dem60 =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4

  # regressions
    dem60 ~ ind60
'

fit <- lavaan:::fsr(model, data = PoliticalDemocracy,
                    fsr.method = "Croon") # "Skrondal-Laake" yielded an error
summary(fit)
